experiments.name: depth_pool
experiments.patch_against_83a4b9c:
diff --git a/lib/wardite/efflorescence/ir.rb b/lib/wardite/efflorescence/ir.rb
index 1073cca..bd3f8de 100644
--- a/lib/wardite/efflorescence/ir.rb
+++ b/lib/wardite/efflorescence/ir.rb
@@ -287,8 +287,8 @@ module Wardite
       end
     end
 
-    # An invocation owns its pools. Active recursive frames never enter the
-    # free list, and overlapping/reentrant public calls cannot share a frame.
+    # An invocation owns its pools. Each function's active frames are a prefix
+    # of its cache; recursive calls acquire the next depth, never an active slot.
     class FramePool
       attr_reader :created #: Integer
 
@@ -297,7 +297,8 @@ module Wardite
       def initialize(function, reuse)
         @function = function
         @reuse = reuse
-        @free = [] #: Array[Wardite::Efflorescence::Frame]
+        @cache = [] #: Array[Wardite::Efflorescence::Frame]
+        @depth = 0
         @created = 0
       end
 
@@ -305,20 +306,26 @@ module Wardite
       # @rbs return: Wardite::Efflorescence::Frame
       def acquire(destination)
         if @reuse
-          frame = @free.pop
+          frame = @cache[@depth]
           if frame
+            @depth += 1
             frame.reset(destination)
             return frame
           end
         end
         @created += 1
-        Frame.new(@function, destination)
+        frame = Frame.new(@function, destination)
+        if @reuse
+          @cache << frame
+          @depth += 1
+        end
+        frame
       end
 
       # @rbs frame: Wardite::Efflorescence::Frame
       # @rbs return: void
       def release(frame)
-        @free << frame if @reuse
+        @depth -= 1 if @reuse
       end
     end
   end
